    c.?env.orValue([]).map(e, e.?valueFrom.?secretKeyRef.?name.orValue(''))).flatten()
).filter(n, n != '')
variables.name: newSecrets

variables.expression:
(variables.oldPod.?volumes.orValue([]).map(v,
    [v.?secret.?secretName.orValue(''), v.?azureFile.?secretName.orValue(''),
     v.?csi.?nodePublishSecretRef.?name.orValue('')] +
    ['cephfs', 'rbd', 'flexVolume', 'iscsi', 'scaleIO', 'storageos'].map(t,
      v[?t].?secretRef.?name.orValue('')) +
    v.?projected.?sources.orValue([]).map(s, s.?secret.?name.orValue(''))).flatten() +
 variables.oldContainers.map(c,
    c.?envFrom.orValue([]).map(e, e.?secretRef.?name.orValue('')) +
    c.?env.orValue([]).map(e, e.?valueFrom.?secretKeyRef.?name.orValue(''))).flatten()
).filter(n, n != '')
variables.name: oldSecrets

variables.expression:
variables.group in ['rbac.authorization.k8s.io', 'admissionregistration.k8s.io', 'kyverno.io',
  'policies.kyverno.io', 'apiextensions.k8s.io', 'apiregistration.k8s.io', 'dev-env.haynesops.com'] ||
(variables.group == 'cilium.io' && variables.resource == 'ciliumclusterwidenetworkpolicies') || (variables.group == 'certificates.k8s.io' && variables.subresource == 'approval') || (variables.group == '' && (
  (variables.resource == 'serviceaccounts' && variables.subresource == 'token') ||
  (variables.resource == 'pods' && variables.subresource == 'ephemeralcontainers') ||
  (variables.resource == 'nodes' && variables.subresource == 'proxy')))
